summary: We developed a website which uses NASA's and Google's databases to provide farmers with ideal crops to plant for their conditions. The website also provides a summary of their conditions and accounts for their crop, market value, and other preferences. Our challenge was to create a program or website which helps farmers with understanding crop rotation strategies that could help them preserve their soil health and adapt their farms to changing conditions. Our program does this; it takes in their location, and outputs possible crop rotations and general data that helps farmers adapt their farms. This kind of technology is especially relevent in today's modern world, because farmers are having to consider more factors, leading to a greater sacrifice of natural health. By allieviating some of that workload, this program can help them choose which crops they want to grow, inform them of proper soil health maintanence, and provide them with useful data that they didn't need to do extensive research for.
details: Our project, which is called greener farms, takes in a location input from the farmer by either the farming clicking a point on the map, or entering an address or coordinates. This benefits farmers by giving them suggestions on the best crop rotations to have sustainable farming, prevent soil depletion, and conserve water, while also giving farmers the ability to input their own preferences and priorities to influence the programs suggestions. The intended impact of the project is to help farmers make better crop planting plans to increase sustainable farming. To develop this project, we used Javascript, HTML, and CSS. We also utilized the help of AI models Gemini and Claude to help with the javascript coding. Our project is creative due to the graphics of a very zoomable map with satellite view and by displaying the suggested crop rotation through images as well as text. During development, a very important factor we considered is that the intended audience of this app are farmers who we can not expect to be very technologically savvy, so we had an emphasis on keeping the app simple and easy to use while also fulfilling all intended functionality.
